purpose: Form DIR-2 is used by a newly appointed director to give written consent to act as a director of the company.
who: Every person appointed to hold the office of a director
when: On or before the appointment for DIR-2, and within thirty days of the appointment for filing DIR-12
steps: Furnish consent in writing to the company in Form DIR-2 on or before appointment.
Obtain security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India if the person is a national of a country sharing a land border with India.
File the consent with the Registrar in Form DIR-12 within thirty days of the appointment along with the required fee.
checklist: Draft the consent in writing using Form DIR-2.
Obtain security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs if the person is a national of a country sharing a land border with India.
Prepare Form DIR-12 for filing with the Registrar.
Arrange the fee as provided in the Companies (Registration Offices and Fees) Rules, 2014.
attachments: Security clearance from the Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India, in case the person seeking appointment is a national of a country which shares land border with India
watch: Form DIR-12 must be filed within thirty days of the appointment.
